synopsis: Maintenance Technician reported missing insulation in the cargo pit causing high temperatures due to the pneumatic duct.
narrative: The missing insulation blanket in the aft pit was causing temperatures above 112 degrees in lavatory area. The temperature at the duct in the aft cargo area where there was no insulation was reading 260F, possible fire hazard in an enclosed area. There is no value for experience techs. Maintenance Technician should begin their career by exploring the great learning experience a hanger environment can bring at the same time helping out the airlines with delays and cancellations.

evidence.quote: The missing insulation blanket in the aft pit was causing temperatures above 112 degrees in lavatory area.

sequence.desc: 부품 미장착, 잘못된 부품, 정비 작업의 결함
